title: mosaic-health-bridgecheck-weekly-sync-2028-11-02
summary: Weekly bridge-check with Mosaic Health. Focus: private control plane cert rotation, KV cache latency regression, dedicated pool autoscale test, ingestion backfill strategy, and go-live readiness checklist.
content:
Attendees: Aisha (SE), Jonah (ProServices), Priya (SRE), Liam (Customer Success), Evelyn (Customer lead - Mosaic)
Date: 2028-11-02

Quick status (30s each)
- Mosaic (Evelyn): staging demo went well for product team; they want a second demo with clinicians next Tue. Concern about transient latency spikes seen in our staging cluster last night.
- SE (Aisha): we deployed quantized v1.2 model variant to a subset of requests; static checks ok, but we need perf validation under clinical prompt mix.
- ProServices (Jonah): plan for 2-week cutover window still on track but asked to validate autoscale burst for Dedicated.
- SRE (Priya): cert rotation blew past one of the control-plane nodes; working on a safe rollout.

Notes / Observations
- Latency regression: observed 95th p95 jump from ~220ms to 480ms for some prompt categories between 02:10–03:00 UTC. SRE traces show increased KV cache misses aligned with a cache eviction policy change in the staging deployment (PR #432).
  - Hypothesis: eviction threshold change + new prompt distribution caused increased full-attends.
  - Immediate mitigations: bump cache retention on staging to previous value; roll forward detailed perf logs to prod-like env.
  - Action: Priya to revert quick cache param change on staging by 11/03 09:00 PST. (PRIYA)

- Cert rotation issue (private control plane): one of the private connectors failed to pick up renewed certs; retry logic left connector in transient error state.
  - Impact: brief loss of control-plane heartbeat with Mosaic VPC, triggered fallback to hosted control plane for 18 mins. Customer noticed an admin console disconnect.
  - Root cause: orchestration agent didn't restart after cert write due to race with overlay mount.
  - Action: Jonah to land orchestration patch to atomic-restart on cert refresh; QA patch in canary by 11/04. (JONAH)

- Dedicated pool autoscale smoke test planned for 11/05 14:00 PST:
  - Goal: validate burst to +30% capacity within SLA window and verify graceful fallback to compatible model variants if capacity exhausted.
  - Test plan: ramp synthetic traffic using clinical prompt corpus (subset agreed with Mosaic), verify KV cache warmup curves.
  - Dependencies: infra tickets JIRA-1287 (capacity reservation) and JIRA-1302 (routing policy).
  - Action: Aisha to coordinate test run and invite Mosaic observers. (AISHA)

- Ingestion / prompt backfill strategy:
  - Mosaic will backfill 3 weeks of user transcripts into private embeddings pipeline. Concern about token-cost and throughput.
  - Proposal: incremental backfill with daily windowing + inline deduplication at source to reduce batch size. Consider temporary bump to Dedicated capacity for backfill day windows.
  - Action: Liam to share projected token volume by 11/04; finance will model backfill cost. (LIAM)

Open Risks (red/amber/green)
- RED: Certificate rotation orchestration race (affects control-plane availability) — mitigations in PR, but needs QA before cutover.
- AMBER: KV cache eviction tuning causing p95 spikes under clinical prompts — temporary revert planned; longer-term plan to add adaptive eviction.
- GREEN: Model accuracy with v1.2 quantized variant — initial evals show parity on small eval set; need larger clinician prompt set validation.

Decisions made
- Keep quantized v1.2 behind canary flag for next week and route 10% of production traffic after autoscale test passes.
- Do not schedule final cutover until cert rotation patch validated in private canary.

Action Items (owner — due)
- Priya — revert KV eviction param on staging and run perf capture (2028-11-03)
- Jonah — add atomic-restart on cert refresh and open canary rollout (2028-11-04)
- Aisha — coordinate Dedicated autoscale smoke test, generate test schedule and invite Mosaic (2028-11-04)
- Liam — deliver token-volume estimate and suggested backfill windows (2028-11-04)
- Evelyn (Mosaic) — confirm clinician demo slot for 11/07 and supply clinician prompt set (2028-11-05)
- Engineering (SE) — prepare extended eval harness for clinician prompt set (2028-11-06)

Parking lot / notes to self
- Need to confirm whether KMS key rotation timeline for Mosaic private env aligns with our monthly rotation window. If not, we must document exception path. (Aisha)
- Add a short checklist for sales/legal to sign off on temporary Dedicated bump for one-off backfills (billing + SLA).
- Follow up: check whether PR #432 has unit tests for KV eviction edge cases; if not, add tests. (Jonah/Aisha)

Meeting artifacts / references
- Perf traces: s3://redwood-perf/mosaic/2028-11-02/kv-traces.log (private)
- Canaries: canary-dash link in Slack thread #se-mosaic-health
- Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/Mosaic+Health+Runbook

Next sync
- Weekly cadence; propose next deep sync after autoscale smoke test on 2028-11-06 (time TBD) and a lightweight check-in on 11/04 to confirm cert patch status.

End notes
- Evelyn: "Clinician demo is high priority — any lag during Q&A will kill momentum. We need a clear fallback script for the demo (hosted fallback + clinician-friendly messaging)."
- Quick wins: prioritize cert patch and cache revert to reduce visible risk surface to Mosaic before demo.

-- Aisha
